children: GEN Restaurant Group entered into a $25 million Common Stock Purchase Agreement with Roth Principal Investments, giving the company the discretion to sell newly issued Class A shares over up to 36 months following SEC effectiveness. Pricing is based on VWAP with fixed discounts and is subject to Nasdaq caps and a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker. The company also signed a Registration Rights Agreement to register the resale of shares issuable under the facility, enabling capital access once effective. Proceeds are expected to support working capital, expansion of consumer packaged goods, new restaurant openings, and debt reduction.
Agreement 1: GEN Restaurant Group Sets Up $25 Million Equity Purchase Facility With Roth Principal Investments
: Common Stock Purchase Agreement (equity line) up to $25,000,000
: Up to 36 months from Effective Date
: Enhance liquidity for growth and debt reduction
Agreement 2: GEN Restaurant Group Enters Registration Rights Agreement to Support Equity Facility
: Registration Rights Agreement for resale registration
: Enable resale registration to activate facility
